description: Gates the designtwin:screen-builder subagent with the same plan check build-screen runs. Claude Code ignores `hooks` in a plugin-shipped agent's frontmatter, so the gate has to be registered here. The script reads the hook JSON from stdin (only when stdin is not a terminal, never waiting on a silent pipe), exits immediately when design/plan/ has no open plan, blocks only on an unexplained colour literal or an unanchored visible design node, never writes plan.status, and stops itself at 60 s — the timeout below is the harness's backstop.
